The '''Cirra Mace''' was a ceremonial weapon that was very important to the [[Cirra]] akia, the most warlike clan of the [[Aramandi]] people in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]].

==Description==
The Cirra Mace was 80 centimeters long, made of black [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]]. It was adorned with [[Emerald/Legends|emeralds]] and [[Ruby/Legends|rubies]]. It was not said to have any strange powers or curses, but was central to Cirra religious ceremonies.

==History==
The mace was stolen in about [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]] by heretics and sold to an unknown party outside the [[Aramand Cluster]]. It turned up fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] in [[Brenn]], but the Cirra were unable to recover it. It was rumored to have ended up in the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Celanon City|Celanon]].
